o.text: Morphologically on üç + -üncü. Cognate with Turkish on üçüncü.
Inherited from Old Anatolian Turkish یارمق (yarmaq), from Proto-Turkic *yār- (“to split”). Cognate with Chuvash ҫур (śur), etc.
From Proto-Turkic *yöke. Cognate with Kumyk ёге (yöge), Chuvash ҫӑка (śăk̬a). The initial consonant is irregular: Proto-Turkic *y does not normally yield an affricate in Oghuz languages.
From gömrük + -xana. Compare also Persian گمرک خانه (gomrok-xâne, “custom house”).
Ultimately from Classical Persian تغار. Doublet of dağar.
Borrowed from Russian микроорганизм (mikroorganizm). By surface analysis, mikro- + orqanizm (“organism”).
